name: Kolide
description: Kolide device security and compliance for remote teams

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Kolide
2. Settings → API
3. Create a new API token
4. Paste it below

checks.name: All Kolide-managed devices pass security checks
checks.description: Verifies that every device enrolled in Kolide has zero unresolved security issues (disk encryption, screen lock, OS updates, MDM, etc.).

checks.name: No Kolide users have open security issues
checks.description: Verifies that every enrolled Kolide user has zero unresolved Kolide issues. Fails if any user has open issues.
